title: Titan Pro 15K Cola Freeze Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Cola Freeze delivers the taste of classic Cola refreshed by a cool icy finish. Smooth and balanced, it combines sweet soda flavour with a crisp chill on the exhale. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil provides clean vapour and reliable MTL performance, while the refill system ensures consistent coil saturation. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
